name: Babelian Lunacy
_notes: Transcribed from sheet DU2475 (Lv I-IX), trait cards DX3224-DX3226, AI DR2476-DR2495, BP DS2496-DS2513.
The Babelian Lunacy never moves (Speed -); it only rotates. 'stair' = Staircase command (cell where the Staircase Entrance tile moves; 'stay' = doesn't move, 'gone' = disappears).
Level strip: lotus = ESCALATION, eye-shield = AT, diamond = EVADE_DICE, A = DANGER (per hit from Lv V).
BP 'atStair' = AT when attacking from inside the Endless Staircase.

traits.End of Hope: End of Primordial Round: Perform Signature.
traits.Tower of Madness: At the start of the Battle the Endless Staircase and all VPs are locked, which means you cannot enter them in any way. Each Wound you deal from outside the Endless Staircase unlocks an Endless Staircase tier up to the current Battle's tier limit. When all tiers are unlocked, you start to unlock VPs. You can only wound a BP III card from a VP.
traits.Wish Away: When the Babelian Lunacy performs Wish Away, it performs: Level 1: Wish Away 9. Level 2: Wish Away 10. Level 3: Wish Away 11. Level 4+: Wish Away 12.
traits.Heavenward: When you are instructed to create an Irem Tower, place it on any empty Battle Board space not adjacent to any other Terrain tile. When you are instructed to remove an Irem Tower, remove an empty Irem Tower Terrain tile closest to the Babelian Lunacy.
traits.Moon Call: When instructed to remove an Irem Tower and there are no empty Irem Tower Terrain tiles, remove an Irem Tower with a Titan on it instead. Start of Primordial Round: If there are no Irem Tower Terrain tiles on the Battle Board, the Babelian Lunacy immediately wins the Battle. Otherwise remove 4 Irem Tower Terrain tiles.
traits.Amongst the Bleached Bones: Normal (not Terrain) Battle Board spaces are considered Terrain tiles with the Chasm keyword.
traits.Built for Eternity: The Endless Staircase has 18 spaces. You climb using the Endless Staircase and Babelian Staircase Rules (see Cycle IV Storybook rules).
traits.True Babylon: Start of Battle: Each player chooses a different language. For the duration of the Battle they can only speak in their chosen language. For each word spoken in a different language, they gain +1 FATE.
traits.One Fool at a Time: When a Titan enters the Endless Staircase, the Staircase Entrance disappears!
traits.Thread Lightly: If you fail an Ascent Check, draw an Obol.
traits.Beginning of the End: End of Primordial Round: Before End of Hope, draw and perform another AI card.
traits.Endless Escalator: When there is at least one Titan in the Endless Staircase, at the start of the Primordial Round, move the lowest segment of the Endless Staircase to the top. Titans on the lowest segment die.
traits.Fate of a Debtor: When a Titan gains Midas tokens, each other Titan gains the same amount of Midas tokens.
traits.Built to Be Broken: Each time you fail to wound, lock the highest unlocked Endless Staircase tier. All Titans on that Staircase tier die.
traits.Total Eclipse: Eclipse Attacks are additionally measured from an imaginary line drawn along the Rear spaces of the Babelian Lunacy.
traits.God's Breath: Start of Primordial Round: Pull 3 all Titans in Zone 6. The Babelian Lunacy does not move as a result of that Pull. End of Primordial Round: Knockback 6 all Titans in Zone 3 away from the Babelian Lunacy.
traits.Ruthless: Remove all positive Trauma cards from the Trauma decks (except Obols).
